use.flag: Read archives as folders (7z, zip, tar) with app-arch/7zip. RAR is read too, but only where app-arch/7zip was built with USE=rar — that flag is off by default and carries the unRAR license, so we do not require it here
Previews of PDF files with app-text/poppler

Remote locations (FTP, SFTP, WebDAV) mounted through gnome-base/gvfs. Pulls gvfs with USE=fuse, without which the share is mounted over D-Bus only and never shows up under /run/user/UID/gvfs, so the program has no folder to open
Windows shares (smb://) as well, through the gvfs samba backend. Off by default: it pulls in net-fs/samba, which is a large build to hand to somebody who only wanted FTP
